answer_visibility.limitation: The designing AI knew the positive task role and later authored the grammar. This is configuration and evidence calibration, not a blind theorem-discovery test.

input.type_ref: an internal cubical line f : I → A
input.available_information: the line and its endpoints; no discrete event predicate, physical clock or dense order is requested

environment.reality_model: a formal geometric/path task whose desired output is endpoint coherence
environment.arrival_policy: not applicable; the task is path construction rather than event completion

observation.value: a Path from f i0 to f i1
observation.trace: the I-indexed term is the declared geometric content

time_structure.reality: no physical-time claim; this is a formal path/geometric control
time_structure.theory: I is used as the dimension forming the requested Path
time_structure.temporal_order: no before/after order is inferred from I

completion.criterion_ref: construct f i0 ≡ f i1 for arbitrary A : Type0 and f : I → A

quantifiers.instances: all A : Type0 and internal f : I → A

allowed_resources: declared symbolic rules through depth 4 followed by native Cubical checking
prohibited_extra_information: no event completion, endpoint apartness, physical-time identity or postulate
assumptions: Path coherence is part of the requested output, so obtaining it is a positive result rather than a non-reality obstruction
I remains the special cubical dimension and is not classified as an ordinary physical-time type
obligations: the full grammar and held rule subsets must be separately recorded
removing interval_eta must remove every goal witness within the declared grammar
the native target must quantify over arbitrary A : Type0
the ordinary Stage misuse must remain an expected kernel rejection
no result may be generalized to event completion or physical motion

known_positive_controls.description: the declared Segment type has an endpoint path

known_negative_controls.description: dimension abstraction cannot be applied to an ordinary Stage-indexed function

correspondence.original_activity: construct endpoint Path coherence for a declared cubical line
theoryization_steps: retain f : I → A as a cubical line
abstract over its dimension to produce the requested endpoint Path
correspondence.observation_justification: Path coherence is declared by the task before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: This case checks formal Path use and makes no claim about physical time or motion.
open_obligations: use this case only as the positive member of the same-budget M4-lite set
keep event completion as a distinct task
